note: Dominica's identity card is the voter identification card that the Registration of Electors Act, 2025 (No. 1 of 2025) and its Regulations (Form 7, re-gazetted by S.R.O. 15 of 2026 on 6 August 2026, read on the Government Printery's site 2026-11-03) provide for, issued by the Electoral Office to confirmed registered voters. On 7 May 2026 the Prime Minister said its issue would begin in six to eight weeks (the Office of the Prime Minister's press room); Caribbean National Weekly (3 July 2026) reported it for July 2026. Its fee, the age from which it is issued, its term and the time weren't found; a fee would be in the Registration of Electors Regulations 2025, which weren't found on the Printery's site.

sources.title: Caribbean National Weekly, Dominica to begin issuance of voter ID cards as electoral reform advances (3 July 2026)
sources.said: Dominica to begin issuance of voter ID cards this month ... Parliament subsequently passed legislation aimed at modernizing the electoral system, including provisions for voter ID cards and stricter voter registration processes. The government is now conducting an island-wide voter confirmation exercise to update the electoral register.

sources.title: Office of the Prime Minister press room, Government Seeks External Assistance for Voter Confirmation and ID Card Rollout (7 May 2026)
sources.said: “In terms of the confirmation process under the new Registration of Electors Act, the Electoral Office has received 16,573 applications from October 15 th , 2025 to April 30 th , 2026. ... “None of the confirmed registered voters have received their voter identification cards and we understand that the Electoral Office will only commence the issuance of these ID cards in six to eight weeks,” he added.
